core-top-1.what: hull core deck and shoulders forward of X 18: the gun step round the main turret ring

core-top-2.what: hull core deck and shoulders X -16..18, in front of and beside the bridge plinth

core-top-3.what: hull core deck and shoulders aft of X -16, behind the bridge

core-stern.what: the stern faces of the core and the engine block, behind the drives

belly.what: the whole underside from below: core, wing body and engine block bottoms

tier-top.what: bridge command tier roof and the pale command dome from above

aft-top-port.what: port engine block deck and its raked shoulder between the drive cans

aft-top-stbd.what: starboard engine block deck and its raked shoulder between the drive cans (mirror of port)

core-flank-fore-port.what: port hull core lower chamfer forward of X -5, the armoured flank under the wing root

core-flank-fore-stbd.what: starboard hull core lower chamfer forward of X -5, the armoured flank under the wing root (mirror of port)

core-flank-aft-port.what: port hull core lower chamfer aft of X -5, under the engine block shoulder

core-flank-aft-stbd.what: starboard hull core lower chamfer aft of X -5, under the engine block shoulder (mirror of port)
